resolutions.researcher_notes: Status is contextual/inferred, not line-specific. Aramco's Master Gas System feature confirms Berri Gas Plant (inaugurated 1977) and the surrounding gas gathering/transmission network have long been operating; the Berri-Abu Ali gas infrastructure is part of that operating system. No source names this exact 39 km line as operating; support is system-level.

Aramco MGS feature confirms Berri Gas Plant is a gas plant feeding the Master Gas System, supporting Fuel=Gas for a Berri-sourced line. CONTRADICTION TO FLAG: the only independently documented ~10 in pipeline to Abu Ali (Saipem Berri Downstream Pipeline, 2019-2023) carries crude oil + sour condensate, not gas. If this GEM row's attributes were derived from that project, the 'Gas' fuel label may be wrong; but this row is cited to OPEC ASB 2012 (pre-dates the Saipem project), suggesting a separate older gas line.

No independent source states a 39 km length for a Berri-Abu Ali gas line. The 39 km figure appears only on gem.wiki (not citable). Nearby GEM sibling entries give differing lengths (Berri-Abu Ali gas 37 km; Abu Ali-Berri gas 22 km), suggesting map-digitized parallel lines; the specific 39 km value is unverifiable from public sources.

No source confirms a 10 in diameter for this gas line. Saipem's Berri Downstream Pipeline does list a 10 in line to Abu Ali Island, but it is a crude/condensate line from the 2019-2023 Berri Increment program, not this OPEC-ASB-2012-era gas line; the 10 in match is coincidental and not a valid support. Unverifiable.

Aramco MGS feature confirms the Berri Gas Plant exists and processes/transmits gas, supporting FuelSource=Berri Gas Plant. That this specific line originates at the Berri Gas Plant is inferred from the naming and the plant's role in the local gas network, not stated verbatim.

Saipem confirms Aramco pipelines connect to a processing plant on Abu Ali Island in the Berri program (Eastern Province); the Berri field's facilities are at Jubail. Supports the Al Jubail (Berri) -> Abu Ali Island, Eastern Province, Saudi Arabia endpoints. Endpoints/province corroborated; precise routing of this specific line not independently documented.

Two independent sources confirm Saudi Aramco owns/operates the Berri and Abu Ali Island gas infrastructure: Saipem (client = Saudi Aramco, Berri Increment) and Aramco's own MGS feature (Aramco owns/operates the Master Gas System incl. Berri Gas Plant). Owner1=Saudi Aramco 100% is well supported for this line.
